lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Notebooks are out of the trailer and off this site. Your engineer carried the crate herself and would not let anybody help.

lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Four hundred and six names with the labour board, published, and me looking for work by Monday. Worth it, probably.

lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Back in his jacket and neither of us has mentioned it since. I have two children and a rotation that ends in March.

lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Canteen's through there and the rota's on the wall.
